questions.passage: Troy was burning as Aeneas tried to lead his family out of the city. He carried his elderly father Anchises on his shoulders and held the hand of his young son Ascanius, also called Iulus. Creusa, his wife, followed behind them. They agreed to meet at a place outside the city. In the confusion and darkness, Creusa became separated from them. Only after reaching the meeting place did Aeneas realise she was missing.
questions.prompt: Who was Aeneas carrying?

feedback.short: Anchises was his elderly father.
